row.name: Expeditors International of Washington Inc. Common Stock

checks.label: not up two days in a row
checks.threshold: up_run <= 1, counting days above +1.0%; veto at 3+ up closes of any size

checks.label: linearity of the prior leg
checks.threshold: ER >= 0.4 or R2 >= 0.55 (both for A+); failing is a veto

checks.label: young trend: first or second breakout
checks.threshold: prior breakouts since the move started <= 1 (0 for A+)
checks.note: today would be breakout 3 of this move

checks.label: narrow or negative day before
checks.threshold: prior day negative or range < 2.0% (A+: negative and under its 20-session median range)

checks.label: consolidation quality
checks.display: base_sessions=8 breakdowns=0 bursts_in_base=0 giveback=0.24 tightness=0.77 base_volume_vs_leg=0.68 base_volume_vs_avg=0.77
checks.threshold: base 3-20 sessions, breakdowns <= 1, giveback <= 0.34, tightness <= 1.0 (A+: 0 breakdowns, 0 bursts inside, giveback <= 0.25, tightness <= 0.7, base volume under the leg's and the 50-session average)

checks.label: close near the high
checks.threshold: close_pos >= 0.8 and close > open (A+ >= 0.9; partial from 0.7)

checks.label: range expansion
checks.threshold: today's range over the largest of the prior 5 >= 1.0 (A+: also over the prior 10)
checks.note: the burst bar is not the widest of the last five

checks.label: higher volume
checks.threshold: volume > prior session (A+: rank <= 3 of the last 60); a base over 21 sessions also needs >= 1.5x the 50-session average
checks.note: volume did not exceed the prior session's

notes: extension: close 2.3% vs its 20-SMA, 3.0% over 20 sessions
prior breakouts worked 1 of 2 (closed higher 3 sessions later, last 4 in 60 sessions)

claude.reason: The burst bar gains only 1.73% on volume that is below both the prior session and the 50-day average (rank 36 of 60), so there is no genuine range expansion or volume confirmation — the two mechanical hallmarks of a burst are absent simultaneously. This is already the third breakout attempt of a 60-session, 19% move, meaning the trend is not young and the easy money has been made. The base in the shaded box sits at the top of a long, extended climb with price only 2–3% above its 20-day average but the prior leg already mature, and the bars inside the box show several overlapping red-green sessions with no real compression.
claude.key_risk: Three prior breakouts in a 60-session move means late-trend buyers absorb supply from earlier holders looking to exit into strength.
claude.entry_note: Skip if tomorrow opens below today's close of 192.60 or if the first 30 minutes show no expansion in range and volume remains below the prior session's pace.

row.summary: EXPD: +1.7% out of a base 4.2% deep. skip 8.5, 5 of 6 criteria.
